scope: Straight uniform bundles; one Hamiltonian helix traversal on the full-period native scaffold crossover graph. No arbitrary custom routes, indels, return tracks, or multiple scaffolds.

interpretation.parity_obstruction: Impossible traversal: parity populations differ by more than one.
interpretation.no_path: Impossible traversal: all starts exhausted without exhausting the search budget.
interpretation.path_found: Verified helix traversal witness only; bp placement, end-turn overhead and exact scaffold completion untested.
interpretation.unresolved: Search budget exhausted; do not prune.
